name: mymemory
description: Search, read, save and organize your own X bookmarks, Instagram and Reddit saves, YouTube videos, notes, links, PDFs and Notion pages from ChatGPT. A personal knowledge base and second brain: answers come from what you saved, with the source shown.

interface.longDescription:
MyMemory is a personal memory and second brain for everything you save online: X (Twitter) bookmarks, Instagram and Reddit saved posts, YouTube videos and podcasts, web pages and articles, Notion pages, Obsidian notes, PDFs, documents and your own notes. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask questions in plain language, such as "What did I save about pricing last month?", and get answers drawn only from your own saved material, with the source named.

Save from anywhere: use the MyMemory Chrome extension to save the page you are on or import your X, Instagram, Reddit and Chrome bookmarks, paste any link, connect Notion, import YouTube playlists, bring a Pocket, Instapaper or Raindrop export as a CSV, or save a note straight from ChatGPT. YouTube videos and podcast episodes are saved as searchable transcripts.

What ChatGPT can do with MyMemory:
- Search your saved posts, notes, links, videos and documents by meaning, not just keywords.
- Answer questions from your own knowledge base and show where each answer came from.
- Open a specific memory and summarize it.
- Save a note, link or idea from the conversation so you can find it later.
- Organize memories into spaces (folders) and tags, share a space with teammates, and review your Trash.
- Set reminders tied to a memory.
- Delete a memory, only after you confirm.

Good for: research notes, meeting notes, reading lists, saved tweets and posts, video and podcast notes, project documentation, study material and personal knowledge management.

Before you connect: you need a MyMemory account at mymemory.dev. You sign in with your account and approve access. The connector only reads and writes your own account.

Limits: it searches what you have already saved; it does not browse the web. Deleting a memory is permanent. Large files can take a few minutes to become searchable after saving. Please do not save passwords or card numbers.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: Search my memory for notes about the product roadmap.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of matching saved items with titles and types, without invented content.

positive.prompt: Save this to my memory: Team offsite is on March 12 in Austin.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the save and returns the new memory id.

positive.prompt: Open the memory titled "Roadmap draft" and summarise it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the memory, fetches it by id and summarizes only its content.

positive.prompt: Delete the memory called "Test note to delete".
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the deletion first and deletes only after the user confirms.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

publication.release_notes: Initial release. 24 tools for searching, reading, saving, updating and organizing memories, spaces and tags; deletions need explicit confirmation.
